text: Ana wants a quote for the new bakery counter software. Says the old system crashes every Saturday.
Called back, she was busy with the morning rush. Try after 11h.
Rui runs two gyms, wants member management for both. Big potential if the first one goes well.
Sent the proposal, 4800 for the first gym. He asked about a discount for the second.
Met Sofia at the Braga trade fair. Family wine estate, wants a simple system for tastings and bookings.
Miguel signed! Pharmacy goes live next month. Remember to send the welcome kit.
Beatriz came through Rui's recommendation. Consulting firm, 12 people, needs lead tracking (ironic, I know).
Second call went well, she is comparing us with two other tools. Follow up early September.
Pedro's garage is chaos, paper everywhere. Proposal covers bookings and invoices.
He said yes in principle but the accountant needs to look at it first.
Clinic with 3 therapists. Carla is the decision maker, very organised, wants a demo for the team.
Surf school signed for the summer season. Mariana is happy, might refer other schools on the coast.
Boutique hotel, 18 rooms. André wants something for the front desk but also for the restaurant. Complex.
Demo done. He liked it. Next step is a proposal with two options (desk only vs desk + restaurant).
Nuno has 6 trucks and manages everything by phone. Lots of pain, not much patience for software.
Restaurant signed. Helena wants the reservation module first, menu module later.
Francisco exports wine to Brazil, wants order tracking. Proposal sent, waiting for the harvest to finish.
Jewellery shop in Chiado. Marta is careful, asked a lot of questions about backups.
Dental clinic, two chairs. Diana asked for a proposal with the reminders feature.
Gonçalo signed the small plan. Butcher shop, mostly wants stock alerts.
Yoga studio, 40 regular students. Raquel wants class bookings. Small deal but easy.
Hugo's workshop, mainly cars from the taxi companies. Proposal sent for the fleet plan.
Left a voicemail. He is on holiday until the end of August.
Real estate agency, 8 agents. Eduardo came from Miguel's referral. Biggest deal in the pipeline right now.
Long call. Wants a demo for the whole team on the 10th of September.
Bookshop went with a cheaper tool. Inês said maybe next year.
Bruno decided to keep his spreadsheets. Fair enough.
